description:
An ENTRY is a dated interaction log tied to contacts. Records something that happened (call, meeting, email…) on a specific date.

Create a new interaction entry. Content supports #tag# and [[tag]] syntax for automatic tag linking.

company_ids.description: Array of company UUIDs to associate (companies are separate from contacts)

contact_ids.description: Array of contact UUIDs to associate

day_block_id.description: Timeline block this entry tells (from list_day_blocks). One entry per block at most: a block that already has one returns 409 with its entry_id. In the app, the entry then replaces the checked block in the day's Journal.

note_ids.description: Notes to link to the entry (its write-up). See link_entry_note.

tag_ids.description: Array of tag UUIDs to link

name: create_entry
